text: 1) Graduation certificate and academic transcript (original or notarized copy, should be in Chinese or English). Fresh graduates can provide the original of the expected graduation certificate. 2) Copy of HSK certificate. 3) Proof of study experience in Chinese and related fields, original transcripts or notarized copies, in either Chinese or English (for transfer students only). 4) Copy of passport. 5) If graduating from a high school within China, copies of the parents' passports are required. 6) Certificate of No Criminal Record. 7) Online payment for the registration fee of 450 yuan (or a foreign remittance of 75 US dollars, and upload the payment voucher).
